theorems.name: Submission.mean_curvature_zero_imp_stationary
theorems.statement: ((∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), 1 ≤ r → Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) ∧ ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) r M → MeasurableSet M ∧ ContinuousOn (tangentProjection M) M) → FirstVariation → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (M U : Set (Rn (n + ℓ))), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) 2 M → IsOpen U → IsCompact (closure U ∩ M) → (∀ y ∈ M ∩ U, meanCurvature M y = 0) → IsStationaryIn n M U
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
